note_tweet.text: I’m starting to realize that love is not the only thing a relationship needs.Two people can have a strong connection and still struggle to make it work.Because a relationship is not only about feelings. It is also about timing, choices, responsibility, and whether two people are willing and able to build something together.Understanding someone doesn’t mean I have to accept everything. Caring about someone doesn’t mean I should keep losing myself.Sometimes, two people can mean a lot to each other, but still be unable to give each other what they truly need.sad😮‍💨
